review_scope: Five complete referenced reusables read, including all eight candidates, blank/context lines and links. Entitlement, repository exclusions, organization/enterprise scope, dated training policy, DPA authorization caveat and UI navigation remain distinct. Linked privacy/agreement/account-plan material still needs separate review; none adopted, executed or rights-cleared.

claims.statement: Business/Enterprise cloud-agent availability is controlled by organization-level policy, not merely an individual repository-access dropdown.
An enterprise-owned organization's cloud-agent enablement may be controlled at enterprise level; assess upstream effective policy separately.
The pinned training reusable says GitHub does not train on Business/Enterprise customer data; this is a source statement, not a verified target agreement.
The reusable describes DPA protection as prohibiting such use without customer authorization; preserve the authorization caveat rather than absolute no-training under every circumstance.
The individual training policy describes an effective start date of April 24, 2026; dates are policy applicability parameters, not proof of current external terms.
The training policy names Free, Pro, Pro+ and Max subscriptions separately from Business/Enterprise.
Permitted individual training/improvement use includes interactions with GitHub features/services, inputs, outputs, code snippets and associated context; do not restrict review to prompts alone.
Personal Copilot settings supply an individual opt-out; rights/data-sharing details are delegated to the linked Privacy Statement and are not reviewed by this fragment.
The paid-plan permission fragment declares all paid Copilot plans; it does not establish entitlement for Free or actual purchases.
The cloud-agent availability fragment declares all paid Copilot plans; repository defaults do not remove this entitlement condition.
The fragment excludes repositories owned by Enterprise Managed Users from its general stored-on-GitHub availability declaration.
Explicitly disabled repositories are excluded from the general cloud-agent availability statement; effective enablement must be observed.
The included navigation procedure opens Copilot settings from the profile menu; file existence or route accessibility is not effective-policy enforcement.
